checks: Standalone Blazor WASM starts from static hosting with no renderer Node runtime or desktop path UI.
The actual OS folder picker grants a live external vault, including binary attachment inventory.
Real CodeMirror typing and Ctrl+S preserve exact UTF-8 BOM, CRLF and Unicode in the original file.
External LF/CRLF changes reconfigure CodeMirror without changing the next save's line-ending style.
The shared note-creation UI creates folders and writes a new Markdown note directly to disk.
Desktop-only plugins are unavailable and Node-dependent plugins fail visibly without executing past require.
Core enablement and the unchanged upstream sample plugin save settings into the selected vault.
Page reload reconnects an IndexedDB directory handle and restores layout, core state and exact disk content.
External edits refresh clean buffers; stale saves fail without overwriting disk or discarding unsaved text.
A real page reload is blocked while a buffer has unsaved changes.
Cancelling the native folder picker retains the selected vault and dirty buffer.
Vault switching isolates core settings, and Create vault creates a real subfolder in the selected parent.
A new vault required explicit community-plugin opt-in, stored separately without creating or resetting an enabled-ID file.

First-open original layout restores real main/sidebar Backlinks panes with independent targets, native filters/sections/folds, pins and opaque state. Resolved metadata/heading/block/embed mentions and unlinked aliases render without changing BOM/CRLF/Unicode notes.

Literal case-insensitive filters, extra neighboring context, lazy unlinked sections, source ordering and independent group/global/section folds work through real controls; source HTML-like text stays literal.

Following-note navigation still selects the exact source range after following switches to that source. Fixed panes retain their target; ordinary and Ctrl-click navigation select heading/frontmatter/unlinked mentions in Source without writing notes.

A stale click immediately after a real editor transaction cannot select obsolete offsets. Dirty undo/redo, physical external writes, source rename with persisted fold remapping and target rename with rewritten references refresh the panes.

An enabled fixture plugin exercises real ItemView/App/file/factory and guarded setFile contracts through its palette command. Invalid state refuses atomically; disable/re-enable preserves state and stale owners/controls cannot retarget fresh panes.

Full restart or actual-folder reconnection restores independent state and a visibly collapsed group. Explicit legacy sidebar choice wins; a real palette-created pane clears deleted targets with an explicit missing-file status and detached results cannot navigate. Original layout/module configuration remains unchanged.

A genuine cache-only GitHub vault imports real Backlinks, selects a linked range in a read-only editor and persists independent view folds with zero network and unchanged content/configuration blobs through return to local browsing.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes; production launch is unchanged.
